info.name: VibeMail API
info.description:
Every endpoint in CONTRACT.md §6, each with a happy path and one request per error code in its errors table. Test scripts check the status and the error envelope `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`.

Set `jwt` after signing in through §6.1 in a browser. Requests under "Needs special setup" only pass while their described condition holds.

item.name: §6.1 GET /auth/google
item.description: Starts Google sign-in: 302 to Google's consent URL plus an `oauth_state` cookie. Not JWT-authenticated. To sign in for real, open `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/auth/google` in a browser, finish consent, and copy the `token` from the redirect's URL fragment into the `jwt` collection variable.

item.name: §6.4 POST /messages/send
item.description: Send through Gmail as the signed-in user. JWT required. **These send real email** to `{{recipient}}`; point it at an address you own.

request.description: Set `inReplyTo` to the original's Message-ID header (e.g. `<abc@mail.gmail.com>`); the subject must match the thread's.

item.name: §6.5 PATCH /messages/:id/read
item.description: Mark a message read (no body) or unread (`{"isRead": false}`). JWT required. `messageId` is saved by the §6.3 first-page request.

exec: pm.test('now read', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ id: pm.collectionVariables.get('messageId'), isRead: true }));

item.name: §6.6 POST /webhook/gmail
item.description: Gmail Pub/Sub push target, outside /api/v1. Authenticated by the `token` query parameter (`GOOGLE_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN`), not a JWT. Replies before syncing; the sync runs in the background.

request.description: Set `email` to a signed-in user's address; the sync then reads forward from their stored watermark.
